**Avoid repeated scans in `_precedes_person` at `services/langevals/evaluators/presidio/langevals_presidio/pii_detection.py:198-200`.** The callback is evaluated for each eligible second-pass result before `normalisation_justifies_span` validates it. When no later PERSON span has the required comma gap, it scans all first-pass results and copies each later PERSON gap. This can add substantial quadratic work on long inputs, but the 524288-character input limit and early stop for matching comma gaps do not support calling the impact cubic or major. Index the first-pass PERSON starts and check only the relevant later span once per candidate instead of rescanning `results`.
